question: Otto’s family learns of his good fortune, and are wonderfully happy for him. They’re so happy they throw parties, and so forth. Otto’s luck is terrible, and he actually died in several loops, so when they learn that he’s alive, and is acting as the Minister of Internal Affairs of Roswaal’s domain, how overjoyed they must be.
answer: Firstly, the Suwen household expected about a 50-50 chance of him dying, so they’re very joyful. On top of that, the entire Suwen household holds a boisterous festival, but when Otto returns to his hometown after a long absence, the daughter of a local authority holds a grudge against him, and once again makes an attempt on his life; Otto is in big trouble. Look forward to “I Went Back to my Hometown, but I was Targeted by a Hitman”.
